title: Looking for a New Toilet Suite Caroma Luna Cleanflush or Better Alternatives?
body:
My current toilet cistern has cracked, and the original toilet is no longer available, so unfortunately I'm looking at replacing the entire toilet suite.
I've been reading about Caroma Luna Cleanflush Toilet Suite from Bunnings] ( https://www.bunnings.com.au/caroma-luna-cleanflush-toilet-su… ) and would appreciate some advice.
A few things I'm looking for:
-Reliable flushing: Good solid-waste flushing performance without needing multiple flushes.
- Good bowl rinsing: Ideally, water distribution that properly cleans the bowl rather than leaving residue behind.
- Reliability: A quality toilet that will last, with readily available replacement parts if needed.
A few questions:
Is the Caroma Luna Cleanflush a good choice, particularly for flushing performance and ease of cleaning as |I have read it sometimes doesn't flush enough?
Are there any better alternatives around that I should consider?
3.Whats the best way to get a discount on the Caroma Luna cleanflush?
I'm happy to spend a bit more for a quality toilet if it's worth it, as I'd rather buy something reliable than have problems down the track.
For reference, I'm replacing an existing top left back inlet, floor-outlet (S-trap) toilet and looking for a standard-height, back-to-wall suite.
Thanks in advance for any recommendations, advice or bargain hunting!
